---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible Ahenk problem
---

Describe the expected and actual behavior, the shortest reproduction, and the output of `ahenk --version`. Include the stable error code and provider model if relevant.

Use a synthetic repository and redact account identifiers, local paths, tokens, transcripts, and private source. Report vulnerabilities using the private instructions in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).
